serena-semantic.name: Serena (semantic code tools)
serena-semantic.notes: Install serena-agent once with `uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent`. The desktop-app context uses the directory Claude Desktop was launched against, so no --project or --context YAML file is required. Name is `serena-semantic` to avoid colliding with any existing `hp-mha-serena` registry entry.
